name: Luxembourg

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and light blue.
flag.symbolism: The colours come from the coat of arms of the House of Luxembourg: a red lion on a field of blue and white stripes.

hook: 'Lux' means light, so Luxembourg has the light, sky-blue bottom stripe; the Netherlands uses dark navy.
trivia: Because the flag is so easily confused with the Dutch one, Luxembourg has repeatedly debated replacing it with the 'Red Lion' flag taken from its coat of arms.
Luxembourg is the world's only remaining grand duchy.
